616:t_1:3.en: ～ $$ラース・バビロン$$ Imperial Palace ～

616:t_1:5.en:
$$執務官$$
「...The $$セントラル・ベース$$ on the Central Asian front has fallen to an attack by $c.」

616:t_1:6.en:
$$執務官$$
「Furthermore, in the Earth side's great counteroffensive launched at almost the same time, 18 $$ターミナル・ベース$$s and three $$セントラル・ベース$$s have fallen.」

616:t_1:7.en:
$$執務官$$
「As a result, the $$新地球皇国$$'s rate of control has dropped to 52.6%.」

616:t_1:8.en:
$$執務官$$
「This, one might say, is the flaw in the strategy of control by points and lines that I have pointed out before.」

616:t_1:10.en:
$$執務官$$
「N-No... I had no intention of criticizing Your Majesty...」

616:t_1:11.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「So long as $$ラース・バビロン$$ does not fall... no, so long as I am here, the situation can be overturned.」

616:t_1:12.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「And when it comes down to it, the Earth side is merely pursuing a strategy of points even more thorough than ours.」

616:t_1:14.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「Crush them, and it is done. I came to this planet for little other reason than that.」

616:t_1:15.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「I have given instructions to $$エルーナルーナ$$, $$尸空#pilot$$ and $$バルビエル$$. All that remains is to welcome them.」

616:t_1:17.en:
$$執務官$$
「Then, with this, I shall conclude my report.」

616:t_1:19.en:
$$シオニー$$
「...Do you intend to win $c over?」

616:t_1:20.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「I instructed $$エルーナルーナ$$ to do just that.」

616:t_1:21.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「I would be disappointed if they obeyed my words, though.」

616:t_1:22.en:
$$シオニー$$
「You are seeking battle, then.」

616:t_1:23.en:
$$シオニー$$
「Even though you know it is meaningless...」

616:t_1:24.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「A mere $$メッセンジャー$$ has no business saying such things.」

616:t_1:25.en:
$$シオニー$$
「The one who delivered me from $$陰月$$ to Earth... I can see now that this is what he wanted to tell you.」

616:t_1:27.en:
$$シオニー$$
「I too once fought for what I wanted to protect... No, I only thought I was fighting.」

616:t_1:28.en:
$$シオニー$$
「Though I knew it was self-righteousness that relied on power, in the end I drowned in that power.」

616:t_1:29.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「Are you saying it is different now?」

616:t_1:30.en:
$$シオニー$$
「The $$リモネシア$$ I love is regaining its beautiful sea and sky.」

616:t_1:31.en:
$$シオニー$$
「For $$リモネシア$$... and the people who live there, I have nothing to fear.」

616:t_1:33.en:
$$シオニー$$
「...Your Majesty $$アウストラリス$$... Please, reconsider your course.」

616:t_1:34.en:
$$シオニー$$
「What Your Majesty seeks is...」

616:t_1:37.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「Do not think my battle can be stopped by words.」

616:t_1:38.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「I will teach you as well. What the world... what the galaxy needs now is overwhelming power.」

616:t_1:43.en:
$$トライア$$
「...To take $$ラース・バビロン$$, a confrontation with the Reactors cannot be avoided.」

616:t_1:46.en:
$$トライア$$
「The reason I asked everyone connected to the $$スフィア$$s to gather like this is to sort out our information.」

616:t_1:47.en:
$$トライア$$
「To sum up the situation, of the twelve $$スフィア$$s, $c, the $$サイデリアル$$ and $$アサキム$$ hold four each.」

616:t_1:48.en:
$$クロウ$$
「So basically it's a three-way standoff, huh.」

616:t_1:49.en:
$$ランド$$
「In the decisive battle at $$ラース・バビロン$$, on top of the usual trio, $$皇帝アウストラリス$$ will probably come out too.」

616:t_1:50.en:
$n
「$$立ち上がる射手$$, $$皇帝アウストラリス$$...」

616:t_1:51.en:
$$セツコ$$
「But as long as we have the $$ソーラリアン$$, I doubt they can use the kind of tactics from the last $$セントラル・ベース$$ battle either.」

616:t_1:52.en:
$$メール$$
「So it's a head-on clash! That's the kind of fight Darling is good at.」

616:t_1:53.en:
$$ランド$$
「Well, now that it's come this far, neither $$エルーナルーナ$$ nor $$バルビエル$$ is going to try any clever tricks, I'd bet.」

616:t_1:54.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Besides, from what I heard in the Empire, the $$サイデリアル$$ Reactors cannot seize other people's $$スフィア$$s.」

616:t_1:55.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Since their first objective is to make us submit, they can't help but hold back a step, mentally.」

616:t_1:56.en:
$n
「That $$バルビエル$$ would be a different story, though.」

616:t_1:58.en:
$$トライア$$
「Whether it's some kind of pact or a functional limit, I can't tell, but avoiding cannibalism is probably the primary purpose.」

616:t_1:59.en:
$$トライア$$
「With someone next to you who's out to stab you in your sleep, there'd be no teamwork or anything.」

616:t_1:61.en:
$$クロウ$$
「From what I know, $$ユーサー$$ of the $$尽きぬ水瓶$$ absorbed the $$スフィア$$ of $$アイム#pilot$$ of the $$偽りの黒羊$$...」

616:t_1:62.en:
$$クロウ$$
「He didn't seem to have reached the point of mastering the second $$スフィア$$, but even so, his power grew to a level on par with $$ガイオウ$$.」

616:t_1:63.en:
$$メール$$
「Then $$アサキム$$, who has four $$スフィア$$s, is the strongest!?」

616:t_1:64.en:
$$トライア$$
「...Who knows... He's a different matter from the Reactors, after all.」

616:t_1:65.en:
$$クロウ$$
「$$アサキム$$ used $$スフィア$$s too, but rather than becoming one with them like we do, it looked like he was forcibly drawing the power out.」

616:t_1:66.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Even so, it doesn't change the fact that he is a formidable enemy.」

616:t_1:67.en:
$$ランド$$
「Right. If possible, I want to do something about the Empire Reactors' $$スフィア$$s before that guy comes back.」

616:t_1:68.en:
$n
「You mean we take their $$スフィア$$s ourselves?」

616:t_1:69.en:
$$クロウ$$
「...Depending on the situation, that might be the quickest way.」

616:t_1:70.en:
$$ランド$$
「But there's the matter of compatibility too.」

616:t_1:71.en:
$$ランド$$
「If we want to be sure of finishing one off, the only option is probably the combination of $$セツコ$$ and $$バルビエル$$, isn't it?」

616:t_1:74.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I'm all right, $n. I have no hesitation inside me.」

616:t_1:75.en:
$$セツコ$$
「It's only that his very existence makes me sad...」

616:t_1:76.en:
$n
「...If only I had the power, I could settle this regardless of $$スフィア$$ compatibility...」

616:t_1:77.en:
$$クロウ$$
「That's theory. I can't even imagine a level of power that could beat a $$スフィア$$ that has reached the so-called Third Stage regardless of compatibility.」

616:t_1:78.en:
$$ランド$$
「The only ones who could do it are machines built from the start on the premise of stealing $$スフィア$$s, like $$アサキム$$'s $$シュロウガ$$ or $n's $$ジェニオン$$.」

616:t_1:79.en:
$$スズネ$$
「So in the end, there's no decisive tactic against Reactors...」

616:t_1:80.en:
$$トライア$$
「We'll play that by ear. There's also the option of nabbing one and shoving it into the $$ＺＯＮＥ$$.」

616:t_1:81.en:
$$トライア$$
「First we crush the Empire... We should put everything into that.」

616:t_1:82.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Right. This isn't a fight between Reactors, it's a fight between Earth and the Empire.」

616:t_1:83.en:
$$ランド$$
「You bet. I'll do it for everyone fighting all over the place, too!」

616:t_1:84.en:
$$セツコ$$
「And I will be sure to rescue the people who've been captured, too.」

616:t_1:85.en:
$n
「$$新地球皇国$$... We'll settle this in this battle...」
